---
title: "Overall survival censoring scenarios — fitting"
subtitle: "One unadjusted Bayesian PH model per scenario"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

scenario_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "06-censoring", "results", "scenarios"
)
model_dir <- file.path(scenario_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

scenarios <- read_parquet(file.path(scenario_dir, "scenarios.parquet"))
```

## Fitting

```{r}
#| label: fit-scenario-models
#| include: false

scenario_names <- c("best-case", "worst-case")

for (index in seq_along(scenario_names)) {
  scenario_name <- scenario_names[[index]]
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(scenario_name, "-model.rds"))

  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    # Day-zero censoring contributes no follow-up, so it is dropped.
    fitting_data <- scenarios |>
      filter(scenario == scenario_name, fitting_time_days > 0)

    model <- stan_surv(
      formula = Surv(fitting_time_days, event_death) ~ tx,
      data = fitting_data,
      basehaz = "ms",
      basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
      prior = normal(0, 0.55),
      prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
      prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
      chains = 4L,
      cores = 4L,
      iter = 2000L,
      warmup = 1000L,
      seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 1300
    )

    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }
}
```
